en: A black-and-white photograph showing a cobblestone street lined with ornate 19th-century buildings. There is a horse cart on the left and several pedestrians, including people in period attire, in the square. At the center is a lamppost or column, and to the right, an obelisk-like monument. Signs on the buildings are in German, with visible names such as 'JOH. SCHRAMM,' 'Drogerie,' and 'GASTHAUS Zum Rathskeller.' The buildings feature typical central European urban architectural style from the late 19th to early 20th century.
